params.message:
Nederland Mobiel: one change of a vehicle is one send

Bookkeeping about the partner is written without model events, the
observer ignores updates that change only bookkeeping columns, writes
from outside the sheet are collapsed into one delayed unique job per
vehicle that a delete wins over, and the observer no longer saves its
stale copy of the vehicle over what the send wrote.

Fixes bevinding 2026-09-30-nederland-mobiel-dubbel-verstuurd
